description: Latest published price of a series (by its identifier) or of the products matching a text: price, date and week, the previous figure, whether it went up («sube»), down («baja») or stayed the same («repite»), source, licence and a link to its page with chart and history. — Último precio de una serie o de un producto, con su fuente y su fecha.

ambito.description: Optional, with producto: «España», «Comunitat Valenciana», «Lonja de Salamanca» or a province.

limite.description: Optional, with producto: how many matching series to return (5 by default, at most 20).

producto.description: Text to search for if you do not know the identifier, in English, Spanish or Valencian.

name: precio_ultimo
title: Último precio
